name: @brass/window
description: Native Windows Window Creation, Configuration, and Event Listening — A Win32 Window Management Library based on Deno FFI

tasks.test:dev: if exist brassWindow.dll (del /f /q brassWindow.dll) & deno run --allow-all --unstable-webgpu ./test/dev.ts
tasks.test:systemInfo: if exist brassWindow.dll (del /f /q brassWindow.dll) & deno run --allow-all ./test/systemInfo.ts
tasks.example:flycamera: if exist brassWindow.dll (del /f /q brassWindow.dll) & deno run --allow-all --unstable-webgpu ./examples/flyCamera.ts
